title: Spark StreamGuard: a streaming, fail-closed guardrail for numeric data in 32-value blocks
description:
Python research prototype (numpy only). Each 32-value block is scored against a reference with S = 0.45·Peak + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·MeanAbs over the scaled residual and latched when S ≥ τ. Invalid input (NaN, inf, wrong shape, non-numeric) always latches with a reason code (fail-closed). τ is self-calibrated from a warm-up window with an optional bounded drift rule; the fixed τ = 0.50 remains available. Constant memory per stream and a JSONL audit log of every decision. The scorer and calibrator are ported from oes512q-latch.

Evidence tags. Demo outputs and unit tests: SYNTHETIC. Real-data benchmark on NAB and SMD: REPORTED; StreamGuard does not beat an EWMA control chart on NAB and ties with the baselines on SMD. Spec targets remain TARGET.

Scope and limits. Research prototype. Not a certified safety system and not a product. No quantum claims.
